anomalies.observed: T3 is a P-channel MOSFET (AON6407, P-Channel 30 V) wired as a high-side series device: pin 2/S is on /+24V_F, pin 3/D is on +24V, and pin 1/G is on /G_RPP with R7/D3. T3 is not connected to ATO_VALVE or the ATO valve load. The ATO valve low-side switch is actually T5 (AO3400A N-channel): M1.J1_12 (ATO_VALVE) drives R10 to /G_ATO, /G_ATO drives T5 gate, and T5 drain is on /D_ATO at H4.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that T3 is the AON6407 N-MOSFET used as the ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch, with its gate driven through R10 and pre-driven by T4, and that it drives the ATO_VALVE/load path.

anomalies.impact: The ATO valve is switched by T5, not by the specified T3, and the 24 V bulk rail is passed through an unintended high-side P-channel MOSFET. This changes the control path and introduces a single series device/failure point on the 24 V rail that is not the specified valve switch.
